---
title: Build with ClipMux
description: Add uploads, webhooks and signed playback to your app.
---

With the Node SDK, an app goes from nothing to signed, encrypted playback in
four steps: connect the app, add one route file, add two elements, and check
it.

```bash tab="npm"
npm i @clipmux/node @clipmux/uploader @clipmux/player
npx @clipmux/node init --server https://video.example.com
```

```bash tab="pnpm"
pnpm add @clipmux/node @clipmux/uploader @clipmux/player
pnpm dlx @clipmux/node init --server https://video.example.com
```

The browser never sees an API key or a signing key. From any other language,
call the REST API and sign playback tokens as standard ES256 JWTs.
